run_cifar10_single_gpu: run CIFAR-10 training on a single GPU using the shampoo optimizer with Hydra config
run_cifar10_ddp: run CIFAR-10 training with DDP parallelism across 4 GPUs using torchrun and the shampoo optimizer
run_cifar10_fsdp: run CIFAR-10 training with FSDP parallelism across 4 GPUs using torchrun and any optimizer
run_cifar10_hybrid_shard: run CIFAR-10 training with hybrid_shard parallelism across 8 GPUs and dp_replicate_degree of 2
run_cifar10_switch_optimizer: run CIFAR-10 training and switch between sgd, adam, adamw, or shampoo optimizer via config
